supplier_financing_debt_relief.description: accepted supplier financing plus debt relief

backtest_protocol.execution_model: Experiment runner temporarily installs rank-3 supplier-financing/debt-relief rows into the accepted-helper allocator module, selects one paper trade per signal date by fixed source priority, applies a 12-trading-day same-ticker cooldown, then overlays next-open/10-day paper outcomes. No shared production/default-off helper changes are retained by this replay-only scout.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared accepted-helper source-priority allocator overlay

baseline_result_file: docs/backtesting.md current canonical baseline and same-run before_metrics inside this artifact
hypothesis: candidate_pool/allocation: the newly accepted supplier-financing/debt-relief helper may add distinct replacement value inside the accepted-helper source-priority allocator because it combines supplier credit funding pressure with deleveraging, which is orthogonal to the current OHLCV, consensus, revision, and seasonal source stack.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by changing supplier source rank, DPO extension, debt relief, ADV, volatility target, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Retry only with closed forward allocator displacement rows, supplier/payment-term provenance, covenant/refinancing context, or a materially different PIT free-data supply/catalyst source.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The supplier financing and deleveraging rows did not add enough incremental replacement value after lagged consensus and volatility relief. The source likely overlaps broad momentum/quality rows or displaces better lower-rank allocator candidates.

pre_run_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: accepted supplier-financing/debt-relief rows enter the accepted-helper allocator as rank 3, after lagged consensus and volatility relief and before rolling peer shock. Existing top-1/day, paper notional, hold, costs, cooldown, core behavior, LLM/news, and live/default orders remain fixed.
pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL window regresses, sample/survival/drawdown/concentration guards pass, and exp-20260611-005 accepted allocator aggregate plus every per-window EV/PnL comparator is beaten. A positive replay-only result is not retained without shared helper/daily parity promotion.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260620-009 accepted this helper standalone across all windows, but prior accepted-helper source insertion often fails the binding allocator comparator; this tests allocator replacement value without changing DPO, debt, risk, ADV, notional, hold, or cooldown thresholds.

execution_envelope.notes: Top-1/day accepted-helper allocator, fixed $4,000 paper notional, 8 max active default-off paper positions, 10-trading-day hold, and 12-trading-day same-ticker cooldown.
